machine name = TK-401 Transfer Line
site = CANON Demo Plant
area = Utilities / Transfer
controller family (reference-level) = Modicon (family-level reference only)
OPC UA namespace = urn:canon:demo:tk401
controller declares protocol "OPC UA (asyncua demo server)" (registry id opcua)
controller declares protocol "Modbus TCP (pymodbus demo server)" (registry id modbus_tcp)
TK-401 is a tank
P401 is a pump
XV401 is a valve
LT401 PLC scaling configures engineering range 0-100 %
LT401 mapped to Modbus holding @ 0 (dtype uint16, scale 0.0025)
PT401 PLC scaling configures engineering range 0-10 bar
PT401 mapped to Modbus holding @ 1 (dtype uint16, scale 0.00025)
P401_RUNNING mapped to Modbus discrete-input @ 0 (dtype bool, scale 1)
P401_FAULT mapped to Modbus discrete-input @ 2 (dtype bool, scale 1)
P401_ESTOP_OK mapped to Modbus discrete-input @ 4 (dtype bool, scale 1)
P401_START_REQ mapped to Modbus coil @ 0 (dtype bool, scale 1)
P401_STOP_REQ mapped to Modbus coil @ 1 (dtype bool, scale 1)
XV401_OPEN mapped to Modbus discrete-input @ 1 (dtype bool, scale 1)
XV401_CLOSED mapped to Modbus discrete-input @ 3 (dtype bool, scale 1)
XV401_OPEN_REQ mapped to Modbus coil @ 2 (dtype bool, scale 1)
XV401_CLOSE_REQ mapped to Modbus coil @ 3 (dtype bool, scale 1)
P401_START targets P401
P401_START request coil = P401_START_REQ; feedback = P401_RUNNING
P401_START requires XV401_OPEN expected True (reject PERM_VALVE_CLOSED)
P401_START requires LT401 expected < 95 (reject PERM_LEVEL_HIGH)
P401_START requires LT401 expected > 5 (reject PERM_LEVEL_LOW)
P401_START requires P401_FAULT expected False (reject PERM_FAULT_ACTIVE)
P401_STOP targets P401
P401_STOP request coil = P401_STOP_REQ; feedback = P401_RUNNING
XV401_OPEN targets XV401
XV401_OPEN request coil = XV401_OPEN_REQ; feedback = XV401_OPEN
XV401_CLOSE targets XV401
XV401_CLOSE request coil = XV401_CLOSE_REQ; feedback = XV401_CLOSED
XV401_CLOSE requires P401_RUNNING expected False (reject PERM_PUMP_RUNNING)
IL_P401_ESTOP: on P401_ESTOP_OK fail -> block-start-and-stop-running
ALM_LT401_HH triggers when LT401 >= 95 (priority high)
ALM_LT401_H triggers when LT401 >= 85 (priority medium)
ALM_LT401_LL triggers when LT401 <= 5 (priority high)
ALM_PT401_HH triggers when PT401 >= 9.0 (priority high)
ALM_P401_FAULT triggers when P401_FAULT == true (priority high)
ALM_P401_CMD_TIMEOUT triggers when P401_START_REQ req held 5s without P401_RUNNING (priority medium)
pump CANON state "Running" maps to PackML "Execute" (official producing state name is "Execute", OPC 30050)
pump CANON state "Faulted" maps to PackML "Aborted" (official producing state name is "Execute", OPC 30050)
OPC UA standard = IEC 62541 (Part 1 updated 2026 ed.); access: OPC Foundation full text FREE (reference.opcfoundation.org; PDFs after free registration). IEC-published copy is paid.
Modbus TCP standard = Modbus Application Protocol V1.1b + Messaging on TCP/IP Impl. Guide V1.0b; access: FREE PDFs at modbus.org
